institution.name: Mohamed bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence (MBZUAI)

qualifications: STEM bachelor's degree with a minimum CGPA of 3.0 on a 4.0 scale (other MBZUAI documents cite 3.2)
English test: IELTS 6.5, TOEFL iBT 90 or PTE 60, among others, taken at a test center
Two referees, one academic and one work-related; GRE optional
One application per applicant per cycle
description_short: MBZUAI's MSc in Computer Vision admits for fall 2027. The application portal opened 7 September 2026; the final deadline is 15 December 2026 (5 p.m. GST), with decisions by 31 March 2027. Full-time admits generally receive a full scholarship.

compensation.value: Full scholarship covering tuition, accommodation and health insurance, plus a monthly allowance (AED 8,000 per month for international and UAE-resident MSc students per the admissions overview)
